hook: This Thanksgiving, give the gift of care
hookSay: This Thanksgiving, as people and companies choose where to give, choose free medical care for families who need it most.

beats.label: Why it matters
beats.sub: for families who can't afford doctors, tests or medicines
beats.say: Every first Sunday, Swecha runs a free multi-speciality medical camp in Hyderabad, for families who cannot afford care.

beats.label: Your gift works
beats.say: It works. {54|Fifty-four} camps so far, with more than {39,000|thirty-nine thousand} consultations for over {11,000|eleven thousand} patients.

beats.label: Your donation provides
beats.sub: 400+ free tests per camp · up to a month of medicines
beats.say: Your donation provides free blood tests, thyroid tests and E C Gs, and up to a month of medicines for each patient.

beats.label: Your donation provides
beats.sub: 810 free spectacles · 34 cataract surgeries so far
beats.say: It funds eye care too: {810|eight hundred and ten} free spectacles and {34|thirty-four} cataract surgeries so far.

beats.label: For companies
beats.sub: CSR partnership for one camp or a full year
beats.say: Companies, make this Thanksgiving count. Sponsor a camp, or partner with us for the whole year.

beats.label: Give today
beats.sub: Every gift keeps the next camp free
beats.say: This season of giving, your donation keeps the next camp free. Please give today.

outro: Donate now at the link on screen. Thank you.

end.title: Donate today
lines: Free camps, first Sunday of every month, Gachibowli
end.small: Swecha Foundation · Figures from Swecha's 2026 programme proposal (through the 54th camp)
